card.name: Noun or article after in/or in warnings
card.fires_on: The word right after a linking word such as "in" or "or" in label warnings, mostly "patients", "a" or "the" before a group or alternative. Also a final digit inside a large number.

modes.label: The phrase about discontinuing in patients
modes.description: The word "patients" after "discontinue [drug] in" in lung-toxicity warnings.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue IBRANCE in<< patients>> with severe ILD or pneumonitis

modes.label: The phrase about a different drug
modes.description: The article "a" after "same drug or" introducing an alternative drug.
modes.example: when restarting the same drug or<< a>> different DPP-4 inhibitor.

modes.label: Digit in a number
modes.description: The last digit of a household count in survey text.
modes.example: Respondents in 7,12<<0>> (65%) households completed the questionnaire
